thread:
Alex R.: kicking off SableHaven private/VPC onboarding — quick sync docs attached. want to confirm network inventory, IAM roles, KMS key owner, and audit-log routing before we book cutover. renewal risk: account flagged as 'watch' due to exec review; Ravi, can you weigh in? :eyes:
Devon N.: copy. I pulled their vpc inventory earlier — 3 AZs, 2 public subnets for NAT, 4 private subnets. need their route-table IDs and peering setup. can they spare an infra person for a 30m call tomorrow?
Maria S.: for KMS — we should insist on customer-managed key with rotation enabled. also need to confirm cross-account IAM trust for our log aggregator role. default retention is 90d; is that ok for them?
Priya K.: they asked for 365d retention in preflight, but security said 90d is preferred. we flagged that as a decision point. i'll capture the trade-offs in the runbook. also tracking: telemetry egress whitelist for our metrics export to splunk-us.redwood.com
Ravi L.: renewal note: SableHaven execs are evaluating other infra vendors. health score 68/100. if onboarding hits >3 blockers in week0 we get escalated. we need low-friction ops and a clear playbook. happy to join customer call tomorrow if needed.
Alex R.: thanks team. Devon — can you paste the quick validation commands we use to confirm route tables & SGs so cs can run before dry-run?
Devon N.: sure. small snippet for them to run from their bastion:

```bash
# list route tables for private subnets
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0abc1234 \
  --query 'RouteTables[*].{ID:RouteTableId,Routes:Routes}' --output json

# verify SG allows egress to splunk
aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0a1b2c3d --query 'SecurityGroups[*].IpPermissionsEgress' --output json
```

Devon N.: also check that their NATs have healthy targets and that health-checks aren't draining.
OpsBot: runbook created: "sablehaven/onboard/runbook-v1" by Alex R. — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sablehaven/runbook-v1
Priya K.: capturing action items in kickoff doc. i've added tasks: 1) customer to provide route-table IDs, 2) define KMS key ARN and rotate schedule, 3) IAM role ARN for log forwarder, 4) egress firewall rule for splunk.
Maria S.: on IAM — we need the exact trust policy. prefer role assumption via external ID. ask them to generate an external ID per our template. also, if they use CMKs with key policy denying account-wide use, we'll need to negotiate key policy changes.
Alex R.: Customer asked whether we can support HSM-backed keys later in Q2 — reply: yes, but opt-in and requires extra procurement lead time. mark as follow-up.
Ravi L.: on renewal risk: propose milestone — if dry-run completes without >1 critical blocking item within 7 days, we'll mark health +10 points and trigger an executive check-in to reassure them. accept?
Maria S.: fine, but only if audit log forwarding validated end-to-end (we need a sample event).
Devon N.: engineering note: we may need to open a temporary peering tunnel during smoke tests to avoid packet drops — will coordinate with infra.
Priya K.: i've scheduled the 30m customer call tomorrow 10:30am PT. invite sent to SableHaven infra lead (cc: Ravi). link: https://meet.redwood.com/xyz
Alex R.: thanks. capturing final action items in thread: @Devon N. — provide the route/sg verification checklist to customer; @Maria S. — confirm external ID template + CMK policy note; @Priya K. — update runbook and capture retention decision; @Ravi L. — attend call and own renewal touchpoint. I'll post a short executive summary after call. :thumbsup:
Priya K.: quick feedback capture: customer wants clearer rollback criteria in runbook (they asked for an explicit 'abort at X latency/error rate' section). i've added a proposed template. welcome feedback.
Alex R.: perfect — if no objections i'll merge runbook changes after the call and send the exec summary.
Ravi L.: i'll prep a short 1-pager on renewal incentives (3 months discount if cutover completes by EOM).
Alex R.: great — moving to action. closing thread for now; will reopen with post-call notes. :white_check_mark:
